  "category": "Frozen",
  "description": "Easy. Quick. Delicious. Simplify busy days with Smucker’s Uncrustables — the easiest kid-approved snacks and lunch foods ever. This box contains 10 individually wrapped frozen sandwiches. Keep them in your fridge for up to five days so they’re thawed and ready to eat at a moment’s notice. Or, store them in the freezer for longer and thaw whenever you’re ready. No fuss. No crust. It’s just The Best Part of the Sandwich, with the yummiest tastes and textures. Each Uncrustables Peanut Butter & Honey Spread Sandwich is made with Unbeatably Soft Bread Baked Fresh in the USA, and packed with creamy peanut butter and smooth, sweet honey spread. An unbeatable combo, with no high fructose corn syrup, no artificial sweeteners and no artificial colors or dyes. These premade snacks are a convenient way to enjoy the tastes you love, anytime and anywhere. Try ’em all!",
